name: grovv-stack
description: Production-first project scaffolding. Drop into any repo — new or existing — and run /grovv to generate the product spec, development plan, technical spec (under docs/), an invocable set of best-practice skills, a project-specific agent team (via the bundled harness meta-skill), issue tracking in GitHub Issues or Linear, cross-session memory, and the README. Conversation-driven and ask-first: understands the product, users, constraints, and stack before generating.
